lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਜਪੁ ਜਪਿ ਜਗੰਨਾਥੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: mere man jap jap jaga(n)naathe ||
lines.translation: O my mind, chant and meditate on the Master of the Universe.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਓ ਸਭਿ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਦੁਖ ਲਾਥੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur upades har naam dhiaaio sabh kilabikh dukh laathe ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Through the Guru's Teachings, meditate on the Lord's Name, and be rid of all the painful past sins. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਸਨਾ ਏਕ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਇ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਬਹੁ ਕੀਜੈ ਬਹੁ ਰਸੁਨਥੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: rasanaa ek jas gaai na saakai bahu keejai bahu rasunathe ||
lines.translation: I have only one tongue - I cannot sing His Praises. Please bless me with many, many tongues.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਰ ਬਾਰ ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲ ਸਭਿ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਗੁਨ ਕਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਮਨਥੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: baar baar khin pal sabh gaavahi gun kahi na sakahi prabh tumanathe ||1||
lines.translation: Again and again, each and every instant, with all of them, I would sing His Glorious Praises; but even then, I would not be able to sing all of Your Praises, God. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਬਹੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਮ ਲੋਚਹ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦਿਖਨਥੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ham bahu preet lagee prabh suaamee ham lochah prabh dikhanathe ||
lines.translation: I am so deeply in love with God, my Lord and Master; I long to see God's Vision.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਬਡ ਦਾਤੇ ਜੀਅ ਜੀਅਨ ਕੇ ਤੁਮ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਹਮ ਬਿਰਥੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: tum bad daate jee jeean ke tum jaanahu ham birathe ||2||
lines.translation: You are the Great Giver of all beings and creatures; only You know our inner pain. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਪੰਥੁ ਬਤਾਵੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਕਹੁ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਕਿਆ ਦਿਨਥੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: koee maarag pa(n)th bataavai prabh kaa kahu tin kau kiaa dinathe ||
lines.translation: If only someone would show me the Way, the Path of God. Tell me - what could I give him?

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਅਰਪਉ ਅਰਪਿ ਅਰਾਪਉ ਕੋਈ ਮੇਲੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਿਲਥੇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: sabh tan man arapau arap araapau koee melai prabh milathe ||3||
lines.translation: I would surrender, offer and dedicate all my body and mind to him; if only someone would unite me in God's Union! ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਬਹੁਤ ਬਹੁਤ ਬਹੁ ਸੋਭਾ ਹਮ ਤੁਛ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਬਰਨਥੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: har ke gun bahut bahut bahu sobhaa ham tuchh kar kar baranathe ||
lines.translation: The Glorious Praises of the Lord are so many and numerous; I can describe only a tiny bit of them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮਰੀ ਮਤਿ ਵਸਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਮਰੈ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਮਰਥੇ ॥੪॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: hamaree mat vasagat prabh tumarai jan naanak ke prabh samarathe ||4||3||
lines.translation: My intellect is under Your control, God; You are the All-powerful Lord God of servant Nanak. ||4||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਲਿਆਨ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaliaan mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Kalyaan, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਅਕਥ ਸੁਨਥਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: mere man jap har gun akath sunathaee ||
lines.translation: O my mind, chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord, which are said to be inexpressible.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਰਮੁ ਅਰਥੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਾਮੁ ਮੋਖੁ ਹੈ ਜਨ ਪੀਛੈ ਲਗਿ ਫਿਰਥਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: dharam arath sabh kaam mokh hai jan peechhai lag phirathaee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Rightousness and Dharmic faith, success and prosperity, pleasure, the fulfillment of desires and liberation - all follow the humble servant of the Lord like a shadow. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਬਡਭਾਗ ਮਥਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: so har har naam dhiaavai har jan jis badabhaag mathaee ||
lines.translation: That humble servant of the Lord who has such good fortune written on his forehead meditates on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਲੇਖਾ ਮਾਗੈ ਤਹ ਛੁਟੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਥਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jah daragahi prabh lekhaa maagai tah chhutai naam dhiaaithaee ||1||
lines.translation: In that Court, where God calls for the accounts, there, you shall be saved only by meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮਰੇ ਦੋਖ ਬਹੁ ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਲਗਥਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: hamare dokh bahu janam janam ke dukh haumai mail lagathaee ||
lines.translation: I am stained with the filth of the mistakes of countless lifetimes, the pain and pollution of egotism.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਲਿ ਨਾਵਾਏ ਸਭ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਪਾਪ ਗਥਈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: gur dhaar kripaa har jal naavaae sabh kilabikh paap gathaee ||2||
lines.translation: Showering His Mercy, the Guru bathed me in the Water of the Lord, and all my sins and mistakes were taken away. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਕੈ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਭਜਥਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jan kai rid a(n)tar prabh suaamee jan har har naam bhajathaee ||
lines.translation: God, our Lord and Master, is deep within the hearts of His humble servants. They vibrate the Naam, the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਅੰਤੀ ਅਉਸਰੁ ਆਇ ਬਨਤੁ ਹੈ ਤਹ ਰਾਖੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਾਥਈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jah a(n)tee ausar aai banat hai tah raakhai naam saathaee ||3||
lines.translation: And when that very last moment comes, then the Naam is our Best Friend and Protector. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਤੇਰਾ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਓ ਜਗੰਨਥਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jan teraa jas gaavahi har har prabh har japio jaga(n)nathaee ||
lines.translation: Your humble servants sing Your Praises, O Lord, Har, Har; they chant and meditate on the Lord God, the Master of the Universe.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਾਖੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਮ ਪਾਥਰ ਰਖੁ ਬੁਡਥਈ ॥੪॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak ke prabh raakhe suaamee ham paathar rakh budathaee ||4||4||
lines.translation: O God, my Saving Grace, Lord and Master of servant Nanak, please save me, the sinking stone. ||4||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਲਿਆਨ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaliaan mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Kalyaan, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮਰੀ ਚਿਤਵਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: hamaree chitavanee har prabh jaanai ||
lines.translation: Only the Lord God knows my innermost thoughts.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਉਰੁ ਕੋਈ ਨਿੰਦ ਕਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਕਹਿਆ ਇਕੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਮਾਨੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: aur koee ni(n)d karai har jan kee prabh taa kaa kahiaa ik til nahee maanai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: If someone slanders the humble servant of the Lord, God does not believe even a tiny bit of what he says. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਉਰ ਸਭ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਿ ਅਚੁਤ ਜੋ ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਭਗਵਾਨੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: aur sabh tiaag sevaa kar achut jo sabh te ooch thaakur bhagavaanai ||
lines.translation: So give up everything else, and serve the Imperishable; The Lord God, our Lord and Master, is the Highest of all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਕਾਲੁ ਜੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਚਰਨੀ ਆਇ ਪਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਨੈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: har sevaa te kaal johi na saakai charanee aai pavai har jaanai ||1||
lines.translation: When you serve the Lord, Death cannot even see you. It comes and falls at the feet of those who know the Lord. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਇ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਸੁਮਤਿ ਦੇਇ ਪੈ ਕਾਨੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kau raakh lei meraa suaamee taa kau sumat dei pai kaanai ||
lines.translation: Those whom my Lord and Master protects - a balanced wisdom comes to their ears.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਕੋਈ ਅਪਰਿ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਾਨੈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: taa kau koee apar na saakai jaa kee bhagat meraa prabh maanai ||2||
lines.translation: No one can equal them; their devotional worship is accepted by my God. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚੋਜ ਵਿਡਾਨ ਦੇਖੁ ਜਨ ਜੋ ਖੋਟਾ ਖਰਾ ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਪਛਾਨੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: har ke choj vidaan dekh jan jo khotaa kharaa ik nimakh pachhaanai ||
lines.translation: So behold the Wondrous and Amazing Play of the Lord. In an instant, He distinguishes the genuine from the counterfeit.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਹੈ ਰਿਦ ਸੁਧ ਮਿਲੇ ਖੋਟੇ ਪਛੁਤਾਨੈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: taa te jan kau anad bhaiaa hai rid sudh mile khote pachhutaanai ||3||
lines.translation: And that is why His humble servant is in bliss. Those of pure heart meet together, while the evil ones regret and repent. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਹਰਿ ਦਾਤੇ ਸਮਰਥ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਇਕੁ ਮਾਗਉ ਤੁਝ ਪਾਸਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਦਾਨੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: tum har daate samarath suaamee ik maagau tujh paasahu har daanai ||
lines.translation: Lord, You are the Great Giver, our All-powerful Lord and Master; O Lord, I beg for only one gift from You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਜੈ ਸਦ ਬਸਹਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਮੋਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਾਨੈ ॥੪॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak kau har kripaa kar deejai sad basahi ridai mohi har charaanai ||4||5||
lines.translation: Lord, please bless servant Nanak with Your Grace, that Your Feet may abide forever within my heart. ||4||5||
